limitations: image_to_video only accepts duration 6 or 10 and has no pinned-frame argument. reference_to_video accepts duration 8 and a pinned first frame, so that single call was used.
Schema has no fps or audio switch. Measured video is 24 fps. The raw file still contains AAC stereo; it was copied unchanged.
The tool returned no Imagine request id and no model name. The same tool call blocked until completed, so there was no separate job to poll.
Container duration is 8.041667 s (193 frames), not exactly 8.000 s. No frames were interpolated or duplicated after delivery.
Source is 768x768. The same seed was pinned as first and last frame. Output is 720x720.
